title: Afterlight Dispatch
archiveRole: First Text Adventure Hall observation sample
description: A deterministic branching radio narrative about guiding a flooded city's last rescue network through six transmissions. Choices alter later calls, public promises return as state, evidence supports or contradicts the final route, and a pure shared engine makes every ending reproducible.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Responsive controls and a single-column layout support a 390px browser-emulation baseline. The narrative remains playable by touch, but the carrier map and persistent transcript are more legible on desktop; no physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Initial canonical implementation for Observation 007 / Game 007. The model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Game code, deterministic narrative engine, metadata, verification, screenshots, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

slotVariantRunPolicy.gameSlot: Observation 007 / Game 007 is the official Afterlight Dispatch observation sample.

verification.completabilityProof: node scripts/verify-afterlight-dispatch.mjs imports the same pure engine used by the browser, replays the six-choice reference path to the city-answers ending, confirms an adverse path reaches frequency-lost, and rejects choices that do not belong to the current transmission.

repositoryNote: Observation 007 / Game 007. First Text Adventure Hall benchmark: branching narrative, state memory, tone, meaningful choices, and a machine-verifiable successful route.
